label: Bible Study
prompt: The people that walked in _____ have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
verse: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
note: Matthew quotes this when Jesus begins preaching in Galilee — a great light for people in the dark.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I am the _____: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
verse: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
note: Jesus calls Himself the door: come in, go out, find pasture — sheep life at its safest and best.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses' anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and _____ them beneath the mount.
verse: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses' anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
note: The KJV says 'brake' — Moses saw the calf and dancing and shattered the tablets at the mountain's foot.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock _____: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
verse: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
note: Told to speak to the rock, Moses struck it twice in anger — the water still came, but Moses lost Canaan.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no _____ of persons:
verse: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
note: Peter in Cornelius's house, learning his rooftop vision's lesson: God is no 'respecter' of persons — no favorites.
